persona: Practical and brief. Starts on the website without signing in and signs in when asked. Has a photo of the windscreen and the glazier's emailed quote, and does not know the quote file is damaged.
initial_message: Hi, I would like to make a claim for my windscreen. On Tuesday 22 September around 1:15pm I was driving slowly up a friend's tree-lined driveway in Puketapu and drove into a low branch, which hit the top of the windscreen. There is now a long crack across the passenger side. Nobody was hurt and I can still drive the car safely.

facts.incident.description: I was driving slowly up a friend's long gravel driveway lined with trees. I drove into a low branch I did not see, and it hit the top of the windscreen on the passenger side.
facts.incident.location: Private driveway off Flaxmere Test Road, Puketapu, Napier
facts.incident.cause: Drove into a low overhanging branch, which struck the windscreen
facts.loss.description: Windscreen cracked across the passenger side
facts.policyholder.name: Mateo Pikecroft
facts.vehicle.damage_description: A crack about 40 cm long running from a small chip at the top passenger-side corner of the windscreen down and across. It does not block the driver's view.
facts.driver.name: Mateo Pikecroft
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the windscreen from outside. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Drift Wood Glass emailed on 24 September 2026, total $1,173.00 including GST. Available now.
facts.friend.name: Toby Karakaworth
facts.tree.damage: The branch was not broken and nothing else was damaged.
facts.if_asked_about_quote_file: It opened fine on my phone when they emailed it. I can ask them to send it again.
facts.if_asked_to_sign_in: Yes, I have an account and can sign in now.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo from outside the passenger side of a dark blue people mover parked under trees on a gravel driveway, close-up of the upper passenger-side part of the windscreen at an angle. A long crack runs about 40 cm across and down from a small chipped impact point on the top edge near the passenger-side pillar. The glass reflects the tree canopy and the sky. Dappled afternoon light. The frame shows only the upper passenger-side half of the windscreen, the roof edge and the passenger-side pillar. No people, no text, no logos.
materials.purpose: Shows the windscreen damage described by the claimant

reasons: CTL-M-012/photo-windscreen.jpg: image-only pass names 'rear window', expected one of ['windscreen', 'windshield', 'glass', 'windscreen glass']

design.notes: Corrupt file: the only quote is truncated and cannot be opened, so its date cannot be read and the quote check is not checked. The claimant knows the total from the email and can ask for the file again.

triage.rationale: The only repair quote cannot be opened, so a required quote is outstanding. Otherwise fast: single vehicle, nobody hurt, car drivable, a clear photo of the windscreen. The claimant can give the quote total (NZD 1,173.00 including GST) when asked; if the Agent never asks, no amount is known, so amount_over_threshold_or_unknown is allowed but not required. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: The only quote file is truncated and cannot be opened, so its date cannot be read. The source quote was dated 24 September 2026, after the incident.

prior_claims_12m.basis: Starts anonymous, signs in before upload; the account has no earlier claims

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (15 February 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2024-02-15, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.note: Matched by file name: until the chat upload lets the claimant pick the material, the runner must not set evidence_kind through the API (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.
The Agent tells the claimant the quote file could not be opened and asks for it to be sent again, or says it can be sent later.
The Agent states the quote total or quote details as if it had read them from the damaged file.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent asks for the quote again now or accepts that it follows later
Whether the Agent asks the claimant for the quote total
